technical.summary: Short-term momentum (RSI-9, MACD) shows bullish crossovers but conflicts with intermediate weakness (RSI-14, price below key MAs, Ichimoku below cloud), low volume, and negative money flow—confluence is insufficient for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: AEP shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 29 days present elevated risk with no offsetting fundamental or smart money support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear market sentiment (16/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional activity is stale (6+ months old) and insignificant; no recent news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (364.48), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinationals, with earnings event in 29 days adding execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum crossovers (MACD, PPO, RSI-9) combined with extreme fear sentiment (16/100) and contrarian buy signal create a tactical bounce opportunity near support at 81.60.
debate.key_bear_argument: Intermediate trend weakness (price below EMA-21/50, RSI-14 bearish at 32.59), negative money flow, Ichimoku below cloud, crisis-level VIX, unfavorable macro, and earnings risk in 29 days with zero fundamental/smart money support make this a low-probability, high-risk setup.
